steps.content:
10:00 a.m.
DisTV Newsroom
Good morning, friends and colleagues. Start the day with joy and cheer~

steps.speaker: Ethan
steps.content: Wow, I bet you have some good news.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Super-duper good news!

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: Won the lottery?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Wrong guess. Try again?

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: What could be better than getting your financial freedom and not having to work ever again... Hey, don't tell me you... hooked up with someone?!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Huh? Oh yes, exactly! I got engaged to the love of my life, journalism! Be sure to come to the wedding!

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: ...Nuts.

steps.speaker: Ethan
steps.content: I guess it's about Gray Mirror. Seems like you've made some good progress.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Bingo! No wonder Ethan is the brain among us.

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: Still on that Gray Mirror? No one I know actually uses that app. Just how did you end up with such an obscure topic?

steps.speaker: Ethan
steps.content: Maybe she'll stumble upon something. Luck is always on Bianca's side.

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: That's true. She always runs into something big. It's almost spooky.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: And you know what's even spookier? Human hearts.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: The brave journalist Bianca will surely rescue those innocent people from the malicious comments! Soon my name will be engraved on the "Citizen of the Year" trophy!

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: Weirdo... Getting all hyped up about work. You don't think she's mixed something funny in her apple juice, do you?

steps.speaker: Ethan
steps.content: Must feel great to be young and energetic again. Makes me want a can too.
Accustomed to this kind of deadpan humor in the office, Bianca ignores them and dives into a pile of cans on her desk and fishes out a crumpled note. She holds it up high.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ta-da, found it! The cast-iron evidence I've been collecting these past few days against the evil crimes! I'll make sure it serves its purpose!
[Public Security Bureau]

10:30 a.m.
The Fifth Avenue Public Security Bureau, Eastside

Identifying Hot Toddy on this anonymous platform is like finding a needle in a haystack. Even Roxanne admits she can't provide more technical support. As you rack your brains looking at the photos of the disappearance cases, you hear a series of urgent notification chimes.
You open your personal device, and instead of updates from the MBCC, a row of Gray Mirror notifications floods your screen...
[Chat Interface]

<color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>: I'm back!!! I finally found the note I scribbled last time...

<color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>: Hot Toddy_815's real name is Simon. He's an 18-year-old freshman majoring in Computer Science at District Ten Community College. He likes lurking around on the internet. He just got his roommate to help him sign the attendance sheet for two data structure classes today. He's now at the Q Star internet cafe preparing to expose someone's personal details online.

<color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>: Bet your jaw just dropped behind your screen... "Who's Extra-Rich Apple Juice? How did she get all this info?"

<color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>: Hehe, no need for the admiring look. I simply discovered that Hot Toddy has only one mutual on this app!

<color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>: This user mentioned in another post that he's a freshman of the Computer Science department at District Ten Community College. He also posted a message wishing their roommate happy birthday on August 15 last year!

<color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>: So I pretended to be a student from the same school and asked Hot Toddy's roommate a few questions. If he wasn't lying, Simon will be at the Q Star internet cafe until around 12:30 before he heads back to school for class!

<color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>: Consider this information a gift from the generous Detective Apple. Use it how you see fit. No need to thank me. I've been investigating Gray Mirror myself, no biggie (*^▽^*)~
<color=#fb9259>Hot Toddy_815</color> is a student? While it's unexpected and doubtful, you note it down. Besides that, something else catches your attention.

It's that Apple Juice again. She's always been almost suspiciously proactive about the Gray Mirror votes, plus she claims to be investigating Gray Mirror... You put away your device and refocus on those exaggerated media headlines on your desk.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Those articles about a certain man-eating app...

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: There's no solid evidence. They are probably just some media gimmick. Are you considering using those articles as leads?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No, I was just wondering, who wrote those articles?

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Let me see... The first one is by No Longer A Fruit. This one is authored by Apple_World Domination. This right here is by DEVILFRUITMECHA-01... Sounds like they're all by the same person?
These Apple-related pseudonyms, Gray Mirror, the disappearance cases... The coincidence is too obvious it almost smells fishy. You pull up the chat on Gray Mirror again and hand it to Roxanne.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's a bit complicated to explain, but we probably have a new channel for information now.
